intro.title: Koko Eating Bananas
intro.body: In this lesson, you will implement a solution to the 'Koko Eating Bananas' problem, where you help Koko determine the minimum eating speed to finish all bananas within a given time limit. You will learn to apply the binary search algorithm to efficiently find the optimal speed in a range of possible values. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditionals to simulate banana consumption and validate time constraints. This exercise will strengthen your understanding of algorithmic thinking and optimization techniques in a beginner-friendly context.
intro.usecase: The Koko Eating Bananas algorithm pattern appears in real-time optimization systems where you need to find the minimum viable rate to complete tasks within constraints. For example, in video streaming services, engineers use similar binary search logic to determine the minimum bandwidth required to buffer a video without interruptions before playback begins. In manufacturing dashboards, this approach helps calculate the minimum machine speed needed to meet production deadlines while conserving energy. Developers encounter this pattern when building resource allocation panels, load balancing systems, or any UI that involves finding optimal thresholds under time constraints.
